description: Create a source-linked company intelligence report from a public company website. Researches company-owned pages and recent external sources, returning an official profile, offerings, market signals, recent developments, risks, citations, confidence, and diagnostics. For agent workflows, vendor review, sales research, and partnership screening; not for high-stakes automated decisions. Price: $0.25 USDC. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired tool result and does not run the tool. Payment is verified and settled before the tool runs.

focus.description: Optional research priorities such as products, partnerships, or risks.

website.description: Public company website or domain, such as https://example.com.

name: company_intelligence_report
